finalists.label: Amyopathic Dermatomyositis
finalists.why: It has specific findings such as tender ulcerations and elevated ferritin, despite normal muscle strength.

finalists.label: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
finalists.why: It accounts for various systemic findings including arthralgias, symmetric joint swelling, and interstitial lung disease.

finalists.label: Antiphospholipid Syndrome
finalists.why: It is supported by the presence of immunoglobulin G anticardiolipin antibodies and vasculopathy.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it specifically explains the skin and lung findings, and the presence of elevated ferritin, despite some findings also being compatible with other diagnoses.
